interface.description: Network interface (e.g., 'eth0', 'br-lan') used for internal (LAN) traffic.

internal_ip.description: Static internal IP address of the interface. If empty, auto-detected from interface.

internal_netmask.description: CIDR prefix length (e.g., '24') for internal network. Auto-detected if empty.

enable_static_internal_ip.description: Set to 'true' to enforce manual internal IP/netmask. Otherwise, auto-detect.

external_interface.description: External (WAN) interface used for public NAT mappings and public IP discovery.

enable_upnp.description: Enable UPnP IGDv1 (Internet Gateway Device v1) support.

enable_ip6.description: Enable UPnP IGDv2 (IPv6 and additional features) support.

allowed_subnets.description: List of allowed IPv4 subnets (CIDR) that may request port mappings.

items.description: Allowed IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

denied_subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets explicitly denied from making port mapping requests.

items.description: Denied IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation (e.g., '224.0.0.0/4' for multicast).

max_mappings.description: Maximum number of simultaneous port mappings (0 = unlimited).

nft_ruleset.description: Path to the nftables ruleset file that miniupnpd uses for NAT rules.

nft_path.description: Full path to the nft binary (e.g., '/usr/sbin/nft'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

custom_nft_path.description: Set to 'true' to enforce manual nft binary path.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable device name displayed in UPnP clients.

model_name.description: Model name for SSDP discovery (e.g., 'Linux Router').

uuid.description: Unique device identifier (UUID), should be stable across reboots.

subscription_timeout.description: Default event subscription timeout in seconds (1–604800).

log_to_file.description: Set to 'true' to log to file instead of syslog.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (only used if 'log_to_file' is enabled).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for process management.

secure_mode.description: Enforce that port mappings must specify an external port (prevents wildcard mappings).

ssdp_broadcast.description: Enable SSDP multicast announcements (required for device discovery).

ssdp_port.description: UDP port used for SSDP traffic.

upnp_port.description: TCP port for HTTP service (0 = auto-select, typically 49152–65535).

disable_gateway_detection.description: Disable automatic gateway detection (useful for complex NAT topologies).
